1. 安装 LibrereOffice

```Dockerfile
RUN apk add --no-cache \
        libreoffice \
        ttf-dejavu \
        font-liberation \
        fontconfig
```

2. 启动服务

```bash
soffice \
    --headless \ # 无图形界面运行
    --invisible \
    --nodefault \
    --nofirststartwizard \
    --nolockcheck \
    --nologo \
    --norestore \
    --accept="socket,host=0.0.0.0,port=8100,tcpNoDelay=1;urp;"
```

3. Java 端调用

需要从 LibreOffice 官方文档中获取 Java 调用需要的 Jar 包。

```
/usr/lib/libreoffice/program/classes/libreoffice.jar
```

Java 代码如下：

```java
import com.sun.star.beans.PropertyValue;
import com.sun.star.bridge.XUnoUrlResolver;
import com.sun.star.comp.helper.Bootstrap;
import com.sun.star.frame.XComponentLoader;
import com.sun.star.frame.XStorable;
import com.sun.star.io.XInputStream;
import com.sun.star.io.XOutputStream;
import com.sun.star.lang.XComponent;
import com.sun.star.lang.XInitialization;
import com.sun.star.lang.XMultiComponentFactory;
import com.sun.star.uno.UnoRuntime;
import com.sun.star.uno.XComponentContext;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;

/**
 * 通过 UNO 远程服务把 test.docx 转换为 test.pdf。
 * 文件内容通过 UNO 流传输，不依赖远程访问本机文件系统。
 */
public class ConvertToPdf {

    private static final String HOST = "192.168.64.2";
    private static final int PORT = 8100;
    private static final String INPUT = "test.docx";
    private static final String OUTPUT = "test.pdf";

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        File in = new File(INPUT).getAbsoluteFile();
        File out = new File(OUTPUT).getAbsoluteFile();
        if (!in.isFile()) {
            System.err.println("输入文件不存在: " + in);
            System.exit(1);
        }

        // 连接远程 UNO 服务
        String unoUrl = "uno:socket,host=" + HOST + ",port=" + PORT
                + ";urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext";
        System.out.println("连接 UNO 服务: " + unoUrl);

        XComponentContext localCtx = Bootstrap.createInitialComponentContext(null);
        XMultiComponentFactory localMcf = localCtx.getServiceManager();
        XUnoUrlResolver resolver = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(
                XUnoUrlResolver.class,
                localMcf.createInstanceWithContext(
                        "com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver", localCtx));

        XComponentContext remoteCtx = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(
                XComponentContext.class, resolver.resolve(unoUrl));
        XMultiComponentFactory remoteMcf = remoteCtx.getServiceManager();

        Object desktopObj = remoteMcf.createInstanceWithContext(
                "com.sun.star.frame.Desktop", remoteCtx);
        XComponentLoader loader = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(
                XComponentLoader.class, desktopObj);

        // 1) 读取本机文件字节，通过远程 SequenceInputStream 喂给 LibreOffice
        byte[] data = Files.readAllBytes(in.toPath());
        System.out.println("读取文件: " + in + " (" + data.length + " 字节)");

        Object seqInObj = remoteMcf.createInstanceWithContext(
                "com.sun.star.io.SequenceInputStream", remoteCtx);
        XInitialization init = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(
                XInitialization.class, seqInObj);
        init.initialize(new Object[]{data});

        System.out.println("加载文档 (private:stream)...");
        XComponent doc = loader.loadComponentFromURL(
                "private:stream", "_blank", 0, new PropertyValue[]{
                        makeProp("Hidden", true),
                        makeProp("ReadOnly", true),
                        makeProp("InputStream", seqInObj),
                });
        if (doc == null) {
            System.err.println("无法打开文档");
            System.exit(2);
        }

        // 2) 用远程 Pipe 接收 PDF 字节流，再读回本机写文件
        Object pipeObj = remoteMcf.createInstanceWithContext(
                "com.sun.star.io.Pipe", remoteCtx);
        XOutputStream pipeOut = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(
                XOutputStream.class, pipeObj);
        XInputStream pipeIn = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(
                XInputStream.class, pipeObj);

        System.out.println("导出 PDF (private:stream)...");
        XStorable storable = UnoRuntime.queryInterface(XStorable.class, doc);
        storable.storeToURL("private:stream", new PropertyValue[]{
                makeProp("FilterName", "writer_pdf_Export"),
                makeProp("Overwrite", true),
                makeProp("OutputStream", pipeOut),
        });
        pipeOut.closeOutput();

        // 从 Pipe 读取 PDF 字节写本机文件
        long total = 0;
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(out)) {
            byte[][] buf = new byte[1][];
            int n;
            while ((n = pipeIn.readBytes(buf, 16384)) > 0) {
                fos.write(buf[0], 0, n);
                total += n;
            }
        }
        pipeIn.closeInput();
        doc.dispose();

        System.out.println("转换完成: " + out + " (" + total + " 字节)");
    }

    private static PropertyValue makeProp(String name, Object value) {
        PropertyValue p = new PropertyValue();
        p.Name = name;
        p.Value = value;
        return p;
    }
}

```
